sentences: Bankers have been blaming themselves for their troubles in public.
Behind the scenes, they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.
Their rules, moan the banks, have forced them to report enormous losses, and it's just not fair.
These rules say they must value some assets at the price a third party would pay, not the price managers and regulators would like them to fetch.
translations: 银行家们一直在公开场合为自己的麻烦自责。
在幕后，他们一直把矛头指向别人：会计准则制定者。
银行抱怨道，他们的规则迫使他们报告巨额亏损，这太不公平了。
这些规则规定，他们必须以第三方愿意支付的价格来评估某些资产，而不是经理和监管机构希望它们能卖出的价格。

sentences: Unfortunately, banks' lobbying now seems to be working.
The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
And, unless banks carry toxic assets at prices that attract buyers, reviving the banking system will be difficult.
translations: 不幸的是，银行的游说现在似乎正在奏效。
细节可能无法得知，但准则制定者的独立性——这对资本市场的正常运作至关重要——正在受到损害。
而且，除非银行以能吸引买家的价格持有不良资产，否则重振银行体系将会很困难。

sentences: After a bruising encounter with Congress, America's Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) rushed through rule changes.
These gave banks more freedom to use models to value illiquid assets and more flexibility in recognizing losses on long-term assets in their income statements.
Bob Herz, the FASB's chairman, cried out against those who "question our motives."
Yet bank shares rose and the changes enhance what one lobbying group politely calls "the use of judgment by management."
translations: 在与国会发生激烈冲突后，美国财务会计准则委员会（FASB）匆忙通过了规则变更。
这些变更赋予银行更多使用模型评估非流动性资产的自由，以及在损益表中确认长期资产损失方面更大的灵活性。
FASB主席鲍勃·赫兹对那些“质疑我们动机”的人大声疾呼。
然而，银行股价上涨了，这些变更强化了一个游说团体客气地称之为“管理层运用判断力”的做法。

sentences: European ministers instantly demanded that the International Accounting Standards Board (IASB) do likewise.
The IASB says it does not want to act without overall planning, but the pressure to fold when it completes its reconstruction of rules later this year is strong.
Charlie McCreevy, a European commissioner, warned the IASB that it did "not live in a political vacuum" but "in the real world" and that Europe could yet develop different rules.
translations: 欧洲各国部长立即要求国际会计准则理事会（IASB）也这样做。
IASB表示，它不想在没有总体规划的情况下采取行动，但今年晚些时候完成规则重建时，屈服的压力很大。
欧洲专员查理·麦克里维警告IASB说，它“并非生活在政治真空中”，而是“生活在现实世界中”，并且欧洲可能还会制定不同的规则。

sentences: It was banks that were on the wrong planet, with accounts that vastly overvalued assets.
Today they argue that market prices overstate losses, because they largely reflect the temporary illiquidity of markets, not the likely extent of bad debts.
The truth will not be known for years.
But banks' shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.
And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
translations: 是银行们搞错了方向，它们的账目严重高估了资产。
如今它们辩称，市场价格夸大了损失，因为市场价格主要反映了市场的暂时性流动性不足，而非坏账的可能程度。
真相在多年内不会为人所知。
但银行股价低于其账面价值，这表明投资者持怀疑态度。
而且，死寂的市场部分反映了银行的瘫痪状态，它们因担心入账损失而不愿出售资产，却又不愿购买所有那些所谓的便宜货。

sentences: To get the system working again, losses must be recognized and dealt with.
America's new plan to buy up toxic assets will not work unless banks mark assets to levels which buyers find attractive.
Successful markets require independent and even combative standard-setters.
The FASB and IASB have been exactly that, cleaning up rules on stock options and pensions, for example, against hostility from special interests.
But by giving in to critics now they are inviting pressure to make more concessions.
translations: 为了让体系重新运转，必须确认并处理损失。
除非银行将资产价值调整到买家认为有吸引力的水平，否则美国购买不良资产的新计划将不会奏效。
成功的市场需要独立甚至好斗的准则制定者。
FASB和IASB正是如此，例如，它们顶住特殊利益集团的敌意，清理了关于股票期权和养老金的规则。
但如今向批评者让步，它们是在招致做出更多让步的压力。

sentences:
36. Bankers complained that they were forced to
A. follow unfavorable asset evaluation rules
B. collect payments from third parties
C. cooperate with the price managers
D. reevaluate some of their assets
translations:
36. 银行家们抱怨他们被迫
A. 遵循不利的资产评估规则
B. 从第三方收取款项
C. 与价格管理者合作
D. 重新评估他们的一些资产

sentences:
37. According to the author, the rule changes of the FASB may result in
A. the diminishing role of management
B. the revival of the banking system
C. the banks' long-term asset losses
D. the weakening of its independence
translations:
37. 根据作者的观点，FASB的规则变更可能导致
A. 管理层作用的削弱
B. 银行体系的复苏
C. 银行的长期资产损失
D. 其独立性的削弱

sentences:
38. According to Paragraph 4, McCreevy objects to the IASB's attempt to
A. keep away from political influences
B. evade the pressure from their peers
C. act on their own in rule-setting
D. take gradual measures in reform
translations:
38. 根据第四段，麦克里维反对IASB试图
A. 远离政治影响
B. 逃避来自同行的压力
C. 在规则制定中自行其是
D. 在改革中采取渐进措施

sentences:
39. The author thinks the banks were "on the wrong planet" in that they
A. misinterpreted market price indicators
B. exaggerated the real value of their assets
C. neglected the likely existence of bad debts
D. denied booking losses in their sale of assets
translations:
39. 作者认为银行们“搞错了方向”，是因为它们
A. 曲解了市场价格指标
B. 夸大了其资产的真实价值
C. 忽视了坏账可能的存在
D. 在出售资产时拒绝确认损失

sentences:
40. The author's attitude towards standard-setters is one of
A. satisfaction
B. skepticism
C. objectiveness
D. sympathy
translations:
40. 作者对准则制定者的态度是
A. 满意
B. 怀疑
C. 客观
D. 同情
